calibration: Many supposed external owners were the commenter's own Gist account or GitHub user-attachments.
Fullsend retro #1625 linked an external Konflux agent PR, but both agents were roles in the Fullsend platform.
A cross-owner link is a lead, not evidence of independent operation or dependent action.

jobs.caveat: bq CLI default max_rows=100; actor of an IssuesEvent can be a label bot while issue body is human-authored
Author is taken from comment/issue/PR user; only event's own text is eligible. Top-ranked sample remains noisy and is not a complete manual review.
